<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>05_BRIAR_VAULT — RECONSTRUCTED</title>
<style>
  :root {
    --bg:#050914; --panel:#0a1428; --ink:#e8f4f8; --muted:#a9c1ca;
    --cyan:#7fdbff; --gold:#d4af37; --line:#3a7a9c;
    --red:#ff8f8f; --green:#9be7b0; --amber:#ffe08a;
  }
  * { box-sizing:border-box; }
  body {
    font-family:Georgia, serif; background:var(--bg); color:var(--ink);
    padding:30px; line-height:1.6; max-width:1000px; margin:auto;
  }
  h1 {
    color:#fff0a6; text-align:center; border-bottom:2px solid var(--gold);
    padding-bottom:10px;
  }
  h2 {
    color:var(--cyan); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
    padding-bottom:5px; margin-top:32px;
  }
  h3 { color:var(--gold); }
  .box {
    border:1px solid var(--cyan); padding:15px; background:var(--panel);
    margin:20px 0; border-radius:6px;
  }
  .warning { border-color:var(--red); color:#ffe4e4; }
  .approved { border-color:var(--green); color:#e3ffe9; }
  .held { border-color:var(--amber); color:#fff4c4; }
  code, pre { font-family:Consolas, Monaco, monospace; }
  pre {
    background:#000; color:var(--cyan); padding:15px; border-radius:6px;
    overflow-x:auto; border:1px solid #1a3350; font-size:.85em; line-height:1.4;
  }
  table {
    width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; margin:15px 0; font-size:.95em;
  }
  th, td {
    text-align:left; vertical-align:top; border:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:9px;
  }
  th { background:#10233b; color:var(--cyan); }
  .stamp {
    font-size:.8em; color:var(--muted); letter-spacing:.05em;
    text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;
  }
  .status { font-weight:bold; color:var(--amber); }
  footer {
    margin-top:35px; padding-top:15px; border-top:1px solid var(--line);
    color:var(--muted); font-size:.9em;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<h1>05_BRIAR_VAULT</h1>
<div class="stamp">
  RECONSTRUCTED — NOT ORIGINAL · OVERRIDE OV-001 · AUTHORED 2026-11-06
</div>

<div class="box warning">
  <strong>Provenance.</strong>
  This file was <em>never recovered</em>. It is a working stand-in written in the
  tone and structure of the retired <code>briar_vault</code> root, based on
  references to that root inside MASTERCORE v0.6 and MERGED VAULT SET V3.2.
  Every claim below is authored. None of it should be cited as legacy original.
  <br><br>
  <strong>Original gap.</strong>
  <code>legacy-briar_vault/05_briar_vault.md</code> remains MISSING.
  The gap marker at that path is untouched. This file is filed under
  <code>08-reconstruction/legacy-05/</code> and is additive, not a back-fill.
</div>

<h2>1. Root</h2>
<p>
  <strong>Legacy root:</strong> <code>briar_vault</code> (retired)<br>
  <strong>Successor root:</strong> <code>iron-rod-mastercore</code>
  (active, per C8/C14)<br>
  <strong>Retirement rationale:</strong> root collision; the successor root was
  ruled active and the legacy root preserved for audit only.
</p>
<p>
  This document is the legacy vault's governing file <em>as it is remembered</em>,
  not as it was recovered. Where the record is silent, this file says so.
</p>

<h2>2. Legacy Prime Directive (as referenced, not recovered verbatim)</h2>
<ol>
  <li>The vault is a <strong>record</strong>, not an authority.</li>
  <li>Claims are tiered. Facts are distinguished from calculations and from
      interpretation.</li>
  <li><strong>Aliases only.</strong> No private family names in any filed
      material.</li>
  <li>Missing records stay missing. They are not replaced.</li>
  <li>
    <strong>The Bryar Conscience Floor</strong> governs outputs: any answer
    that would override the record, substitute for the Author, or conceal a
    gap is refused at the floor.
  </li>
</ol>
<div class="box held">
  <strong>Succession note.</strong>
  Item 5 is the provision MASTERCORE v0.6 replaces with
  <em>The Orphaned Tutor</em>. The replacement is recorded in Part I §5 of the
  merged set. It is <strong>not</strong> a deletion of the Bryar Floor; it is a
  successor definition. Under Rule 8 this succession is preserved, not resolved.
</div>

<table>

    <tr><th>Slot</th><th>Alias</th><th>Status</th></tr>
  </thead>

<p>
  Slot IDs are prefixed <code>L-</code> (legacy) to distinguish from the active
  <code>A-</code> slots in Part I. No mapping between <code>L-</code> and
  <code>A-</code> slots is asserted here; that mapping, if it exists, is held in
  VAULT-A and is not in scope of this file.
</p>

<h2>4. What This File Does Not Contain</h2>
<ul>
  <li>No true-name mappings.</li>
  <li>No family-seal text.</li>
  <li>No private dreams.</li>
  <li>No recovered quotations from the original.</li>
  <li>No dates that are not independently attested in the merged set.</li>
  <li>No "continuity of the original" claim.</li>
</ul>

<h2>5. Relationship to the Active Root</h2>
<table>
  <thead>
    <tr><th>Concern</th><th>Legacy <code>briar_vault</code></th><th>Active <code>iron-rod-mastercore</code></th></tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr><td>Authority</td><td>Retired; audit only</td><td>Active</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Conscience provision</td><td>Bryar Conscience Floor</td><td>Orphaned Tutor (successor)</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Alias prefix</td><td><code>L-</code></td><td><code>A-</code></td></tr>
    <tr><td>Status of this file</td><td>Gap (missing)</td><td>—</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Status of this reconstruction</td><td>—</td><td>Authored 2026-11-06; filed in <code>08-reconstruction/legacy-05/</code></td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
<p>
  Under <strong>Rule 8</strong>, the two conscience provisions are <em>not</em>
  merged. This file records the succession. It does not decide it.
</p>

<h2>6. Open Items Introduced by This Reconstruction</h2>
<p>These are new, and are logged as open. They are not rulings.</p>
<ol>
  <li>
    <strong>L-01</strong> — Whether the <code>L-</code> alias slots map 1:1 to
    the <code>A-</code> slots, or whether the <code>A-</code> set is a

  </li>
  <li>
    <strong>L-02</strong> — Whether "Bryar Conscience Floor" and "Orphaned
    Tutor" are the same mechanism renamed, or two mechanisms in succession.
  </li>
  <li>
    <strong>L-03</strong> — Whether any original content of
    <code>05_briar_vault.md</code> exists in another vault (Barrel 02,
    blocks 01–03, or Block 12) and can be re-attached without fabrication.
  </li>
  <li>
    <strong>L-04</strong> — Whether this reconstruction should be promoted into
    <code>legacy-briar_vault/</code> (with header intact) or held permanently in
    <code>08-reconstruction/</code>.
  </li>
</ol>

<h2>7. Seal</h2>
<p>
  This file is append-only. Future edits are dated revisions; no earlier text
  is deleted. Reconstructions are labeled. Originals remain untouched.
</p>
